assignment_control.binding: match literal tuple/list shapes; write local names and chained targets left-to-right.
assignment_control.boundary: no starred targets, arbitrary iterables, container-valued bindings, attribute/subscript writes, annotations or implicit unpacking exceptions.
assignment_control.evaluation: evaluate all scalar RHS leaves left-to-right once before any target write.
assignment_control.limits: 64 RHS shape nodes, 64 target names, 64 chained targets and nesting depth 16 per assignment.

assumptions: scalar values; no aliases, monkey patching or implicit flows.
explicit raises terminate; implicit exceptions, handlers and resource effects are outside this model.
finite origin sets; joins lose branch correlation; traces are derivations, not executable paths.

call_binding.binding: positional slots followed by exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: no evaluated or mutable defaults, annotations, referenced variadics, extra variadic arguments, unpacking, coroutine or generator execution, keyword external-rule contracts or non-normalized identifier spellings.
call_binding.defaults: omitted slots use source-free immutable scalar literals; explicit arguments override defaults; analysis refuses definition-time effects.
call_binding.definitions: Unannotated ASCII signatures with immutable literal defaults defer bodies, including referenced variadics. Calls require scalar fixed slots.
call_binding.evaluation: explicit argument values in source order before parameter binding; once per transfer.
call_binding.initialization: ASCII scalar bindings, literal __all__, plain classes and unchanged default construction are inert. Global value flow, collisions and other effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.invalid: incomplete analysis for missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII-named positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only parameters; required or immutable literal defaults.
call_binding.variadics: fixed-slot summaries omit unused, unannotated ASCII variadic parameters. Their names must never occur as body identifiers; calls bind only fixed slots.
